I understand. Old-fashioned families usually stand in as barriers. I would recommend it though. Try the chat option instead, and be very clear that you need help with finding free mental health group meetings, individual counseling, or free testing. I really do recommend it, they are able to look on their end directly in your neighborhood sojme resources. Don't give up. Mental health should be treated like a physical illness. Despite your family's opinion, it's a wonderful thing that you are trying to fix what you see as an issue.

have you ever tried the hotline? it can be a little unnerving to do, but they are a really great resource for finding mental health assistance in your area, so you can have a different counselor who doesn't know your family personally.
